corrections.text: The article says "Of 94 rows" on the Learn az logicapp command reference, 78 are typed Extension and 16 typed Core. The table has 95 rows: 78 Extension, 16 Core and one typed "Core and Extension" (az logicapp deployment, status GA, a group that contains the extension's deployment package command). Its statement that the 19 groups match InfoQ's figure holds only for rows typed Extension; counting every row with commands beneath it, including the shared deployment row, gives 20 groups that contain extension commands.

The article reports that the extension's README says 59. The same README also refers once, in its testing section, to "55-command extension surface" remaining independently asserted, a third figure the article does not mention and does not explain. The README's 59 appears in the sentence "The complete extension contributes 59 leaves"; the release history gives only 59.
